investigations.title: Mill Street Barracks
investigations.description: Back to the barracks. A former military stronghold with unexplained footsteps in empty corridors and shadow figures reported on the upper floors. Team investigation with full equipment sweep.

investigations.title: Clifton Masonic Temple
investigations.description: Behind closed doors at the Masonic Temple — ritual chambers, hidden cellars and a history few outsiders have seen. One of our most requested locations.

investigations.title: 30 East Drive
investigations.description: The most violent poltergeist haunting in Europe — home of the infamous Black Monk of Pontefract. Strictly limited to 6 investigators. Not for the faint-hearted.

investigations.title: Lancaster Castle & Gaol
investigations.description: Nearly a thousand years of imprisonment, trials and executions — including the Pendle Witches. One of the most historically dark buildings in the North of England.

investigations.title: Castle of Park
investigations.description: A full weekend locked inside a 16th-century Scottish tower house. Residential investigation limited to just 5 investigators — our biggest expedition of the year.

announcements.title: Ghost Hunter App — Beta Live!
announcements.body: You're using it right now. Real EMF readings, EVP recording, SLS camera with entity tracking and a voiced spirit box — all running on your phone's actual sensors. Found a bug or got an idea? Message us on Facebook.

announcements.title: Take the App on a Hunt
announcements.body: Coming to an investigation with us? Bring Ghost Hunter along — run the SLS camera and EVP recorder side by side with our professional kit and compare the evidence.
